DO NOT PROCEED = unresolved safety/feasibility barrier after attempted mitigation. CAUTION = relative risk requiring expert planning, not an automatic exclusion. This row is largely tumor-agnostic; disease extent, transplant strategy and regimen-specific eligibility remain in the
roadmap. Device labeling and individual organ-at-risk constraints govern final planning.
REASSESS → preserve liver reserve and the next potentially curative option

Assess viable tumor, other disease, toxicity and reserve. Revisit complete-treatment options. If transplant is chosen, apply the full OPTN pathway; local response alone does not establish listing eligibility.

LC, local control; CR, complete response; OS, overall survival; PFS, progression-free survival; LPFS, local progression-free survival; RFS, recurrence-free survival. PMID links identify study evidence; selection thresholds also reflect the cited guidelines. No treatment is guaranteed curative.
NCCN Biliary Tract Cancers v1.2026, original PDF p22 (INTRA-D); perihilar pathway pp23-27. Full selection and allocation criteria: practice guideline and alignment worksheet.

svg.text: LRT evidence update 23 October 2026 — institutional decisions pending
LT: approved neoadjuvant therapy and operative staging; OPTN does not mandate RT. Mass single and <3 cm for allocation. Avoid primary transperitoneal
biopsy. Welling 24115315; Soliman 39936132; Hoogwater 37032423: observational protocol evidence, not equivalence.
Non-LT RT: selected MDT option. NCCN v1.2026 PDF p23 allows chemoradiation without prior systemic control; BSG supports SBRT/PBT after systemic therapy.
No proven routine survival gain. STRONG: grade 3 cholangitis 5/6 (34439146); ABC-07: no PFS gain (ASCO2024 abstract4006).
Postoperative RT: NCCN PDF p24 includes R1 or node-positive disease; nonpreferred option for R0/node-negative disease. Systemic therapy and trial are
Endobiliary RFA: recent RCTs did not show survival/patency benefit (40619373,37652677). PDT: not recommended outside trials (30094069). I-125 stent plus
HAIC: investigational, both arms had HAIC (39311927).
No established routine primary hilar role for Y90, TACE, thermal ablation or histotripsy. Drainage, infection control and bowel/bile-duct constraints
